category_edits.rationale: Across all four datasets, exponent 0.75 weakens attenuation of moderately frequent history items while retaining maximum attenuation for the most frequent items. Counts remain training-only, unseen-item features remain zero, and inference loads the saved feature buffer. Embeddings, topology, readout, loss and optimizer remain unchanged.

change_summary: Change the normalized training-frequency feature exponent from 0.50 to 0.75 for all four category models; retain attenuation 1-0.3*feature and existing checkpoint/predictor compatibility.
